name: Alan Garcia
office: City of South Gate, Member of the City Council

items.text: Alan Garcia works as a data analyst for the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services. He previously worked as a patient-transport team lead at Cedars-Sinai and a patient transporter at St. John’s Health Center. He says he is studying nursing.

items.text: Garcia says he is running because he is tired of little change in the city. His campaign website states that he has a plan to address the city’s deficit and hold the council accountable.
